rationale.complete: Round 2 done (non-reserved): dated pre-registration of genre control, an OU drift-and-reset model and a function-word charge; synthetic validation on real schedules for every estimator, with two estimator fixes (clipping, agent-scaled NE41 pairs) as amendments before real data; second embedding model; 87 per-unit estimate rows; round-2 blocks in 13 period READMEs. No holdout run; R4 (attribution monitor) and R5 (lab susceptibility) not run.
rationale.faithfulness: Strict conservation stays refuted. What survives is sharper: the erasure, judge and Prankster style moves are not speech-act genre (erasure T 0.546 [0.522, 0.564] after genre and position control; content flat with bge and gte). The pre-registered OU drift form failed its kill rule; a per-segment offset redrawn at each erasure fits (post hoc). Function words are not a conserved charge but add identity (0.85 with style). Scorecard A1 B1 C1 D1 E2 F2 G1 H1 I1.
rationale.usefulness: A cheap attribution fingerprint (function words plus formatting rates, 0.85 across a goal switch vs 0.51 for embeddings) with a quantified warning: each forced context erasure redraws about 5% of style variance regardless of speech act, so monitors should compare within a context segment or against multi-segment means.

one_line: Style is an identity charge plus a context-held offset that each forced erasure redraws (T 0.546 after genre control; content flat); style plus function words identify agents at 0.85.

models.note: Strict conservation refuted; OU drift-and-reset failed; per-segment offset redrawn at erasure fits (post hoc)

v2.claim: An agent's style is a stable identity charge plus a context-held offset that each forced erasure redraws: across exogenous erasures style moves (T 0.546 [0.522, 0.564] after removing genre and context position) while content does not (0.51, both embedding models); style plus function words identify agents across goal switches at 0.85 (content 0.51, chance 0.15)
v2.scope: regime III, 23 units; 24 non-reserved goal switches
v2.decision: attribution and model-swap monitoring: use style + function-word rates, compare at matched context position
v2.rater: 2 raters (coordinator + blind); log-odds mean credence, mean V; mechanism level = lower of the two; Δp 0.04, ΔV 0.50 (no adjudication needed)
